item.title: Nick Reiner to be arraigned in killing of parents Rob and Michele Singer Reiner
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Nick Reiner is set to be arraigned and enter a plea Wednesday in the killing of his parents, Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner .

item.title: Actor Awards, formerly SAG Awards, will announce nominations Wednesday
item.description: Not all award shows require you to get up early in the morning to hear the nominations read. The Actor Awards, formerly the SAG Awards, will announce nominations Wednesday at 1 p.m. EST on Netflix's YouTube Channel.

item.title: Saint-Tropez bids adieu to Brigitte Bardot with a funeral and public homage
item.description: PARIS (AP) — Brigitte Bardot's funeral will be held Wednesday with a private service in Saint-Tropez and a public homage at the French Riviera resort where she lived for more than half a century after retiring from movie stardom at the height of he

item.title: NHL roundup: Miller scores twice, Svechnikov adds four assists as Hurricanes beat Stars 6-3
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (AP) — K’Andre Miller scored twice while Andrei Svechnikov had four assists as the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Dallas Stars 6-3 on Tuesday night.

item.title: McDavid nets hat trick as Oilers drill Predators 6-2
item.description: EDMONTON — Connor McDavid scored three goals, including one on a penalty shot, and Leon Draisaitl had a goal and two assists as the Edmonton Oilers came away with a 6-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Tuesday.

item.title: The coolest technology from Day 2 of CES 2026
item.description: LAS VEGAS (AP) — Crowds flooded the freshly opened showroom floors on Day 2 of the CES and were met by thousands of robots, AI companions, assistants, health longevity tech, wearables and more.

item.title: Yemen anti-Houthi council expels separatist leader and says he faces treason charges
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — A council fighting against Yemen’s Houthi rebels said Wednesday it had expelled the leader of a separatist movement and charged him with treason after he reportedly declined to travel to Saudi Arabia for talks.
